_source: Episodes the story-echo search (plan 6.18) needed and the event lists did not have, 2026-10-04. Each is the Berean editors' own section or sections that hold the steps a told-again pair quotes, titled by the heading of the section holding most of them (the others kept as aliases). Built by tools/events/event_nodes.py exactly as the listed events are; the credit is the editors'. Doug: 'move onto the 57'. 2026-10-04 (later): eleven more, for references in the letters (plan 6.21) to a happening no event had -- the section holding the account words the letter's reference was checked against. 2026-10-05: more, for references in the psalms and poems (plan 6.19), where no event held the account words the poem was checked against, or the event that did was over three times the section and over 40 verses (Psalm 3's flight from Absalom had sat on a 194-verse event). 2026-10-06: more, for references between the prophets and events (plan 6.20), by the same rule as 6.19's as it actually ran: where no event held the account words, or the event that did was over three times the section and over 20 verses.
